name: lever t-bar reverse grip row
description: A T-bar style machine row done standing bent over with a reverse grip. It works the upper back, lats and biceps.
instructions: Stand on the platform with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the handles underhand.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
